content: Disney is testing a new AI-powered tool for Disney Plus that uses a natural language search, a voice query, or a suggested prompt to create a customized row of show and movie recommendations. Disney Plus, like other streaming services, can recommend shows to watch based on your viewing history. But the company says this new tool, which is “a limited beta experiment” that’s in testing with a “small group of select subscribers,” is intended to recommend content that “fits the moment.” [Image: Sorry this is grainy; I grabbed it from a GIF. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-07-at-10.44.34-AM.png?quality=90&strip=all] The feature is the latest in a broader push to offer AI-powered recommendation tools that help you find something to watch among massive catalogs of streaming content. Netflix started testing an OpenAI-powered conversational search tool last year and also has a native voice search feature. Last week, Warner Bros. Discovery announced it is experimenting with a “conversational search experience” for HBO Max as well. Peacock even recently added an AI Andy Cohen that narrates Bravo clips. In an earnings call this week, Disney CEO Josh D’Amaro doubled down on plans to make Disney Plus the “digital centerpiece” of the company with “increased personalization, exclusivity, and benefits for subscribers.” Disney is also introducing an “AI-assisted” conversational search experience for ESPN that looks more like a traditional AI chatbot. ESPN Search, which is in beta with a “subset” of users, lets users ask questions and get answers, stats, and recommendations “drawn from ESPN’s vast sports knowledge ecosystem,” the company says. [Image: Disney has a GIF of ESPN Search in motion, too. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-07-at-10.51.38-AM.png?quality=90&strip=all]

chineseContent: 迪士尼正在为迪士尼+测试一款新的人工智能驱动工具，该工具使用自然语言搜索、语音查询或建议提示来创建定制的节目和电影推荐行。与其他流媒体服务一样，迪士尼+可以根据您的观看历史记录推荐观看的节目。但该公司表示，这个新工具是“有限的测试版实验”，正在对“一小群精选订阅者”进行测试，旨在推荐“适合当下”的内容。 [图片：抱歉，这是颗粒状的；我从 GIF 中抓取了它。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-07-at-10.44.34-AM.png?quality=90&strip=all] 该功能是更广泛推动提供人工智能驱动的推荐工具的最新功能，可帮助您在大量流媒体内容目录中找到可观看的内容。 Netflix 去年开始测试由 OpenAI 驱动的对话搜索工具，并且还具有原生语音搜索功能。上周，华纳兄弟探索频道宣布也正在为 HBO Max 试验“对话式搜索体验”。 Peacock 甚至最近添加了一个人工智能安迪·科恩 (Andy Cohen) 来为 Bravo 片段进行旁白。在本周的财报电话会议上，迪士尼首席执行​​官乔什·达马罗（Josh D’Amaro）加倍强调了将 Disney+ 打造成公司“数字核心”的计划，“增强了个性化、排他性，并为订户带来了更多好处”。迪士尼还为 ESPN 推出了“人工智能辅助”对话式搜索体验，看起来更像传统的人工智能聊天机器人。该公司表示，ESPN 搜索目前处于测试阶段，只有一小部分用户可以提出问题并获得“来自 ESPN 庞大的体育知识生态系统”的答案、统计数据和建议。 [图片：迪士尼也有 ESPN 搜索的 GIF 动图。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-conten
